verdict.rationale: Nitrokey is not itself an agent. It ships an official CLI (nitropy), a Python SDK and a NetHSM REST API, so an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server or MCP endpoint, and the CLI, SDK and REST API are developer building blocks, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
